correctness.rationale: A four-point shattered set would lie in a one-coordinate star; otherwise three arms from at least two coordinate lines have the star center as unique common radius-one center, impossible for the trace omitting the fourth point. In two coordinates every ball is a row-plus-column cross, which implies an exact 3-by-4 availability condition for three-point shattering. All low-parameter cases and constructive eight-trace witnesses are proved. The dependency-free checker directly enumerates 14,580 anchored candidates over nineteen products, corroborating but not replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact finite graph VC dimension for every product of nontrivial complete graphs, with arbitrary unequal coordinate alphabets, sharp uniform bound and the exact two-factor transition. This refines the 2020 literature statement that closed Hamming neighborhoods merely have bounded VC dimension. The binary three-cube provides a substantive strict separation from published open-neighborhood classification, relevant to VC learning and graph ball traces.
